comments.story: E-scooter company Spin apparently uses Raspberry Pi 4s as part of their vehicles
comments.why: Background on hobbyists losing out during the Pi shortage.
comments.text: I'm still upset that Raspberry Pi was focused on ensuring institutional customers (like these electric scooters) could order thousands of Pis, while leaving hobbyists trying to order single-digit quantities scrambling through years-long waiting lists and listings which get snapped up in seconds ( [VIDEO] ).

comments.why: Covers Raspberry Pi shortage and business-customer prioritization.
comments.text: They've chosen to prioritize selling to businesses ordering hundreds of Pis for field-deployed devices, over individual hobbyists ordering single-digit quantities for tinkering and hacking ( [VIDEO] ).
